gaps.title: No approved Depth knowledge release
gaps.whyItMatters: The packaged release (candidate manifest, claim levels, operator stage-area ratings) carries no approval record, so the runtime abstains (BLOCKED_AWAITING_APPROVED_RELEASE).
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether any effective-depth number may be shown at all.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when Michael records a scientific approval for a named release, or rejects it.
gaps.expectedOutput: An approval record and a new APPROVED release id.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Scientific validation approval plus owner approval (PROJECT §7).

gaps.title: Effective depth is not field-validated
gaps.whyItMatters: The shift arithmetic is unit-tested; effective depth on known flats has no bowfishing field truth (preregistered plan in research/tools/depth_research/records/field_validation_prereg.json).
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether a flat is shallower or deeper than usual tonight.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the preregistered field validation is run and scored, or Michael defers it.
gaps.expectedOutput: A PASSED / FAILED / INSUFFICIENT_DATA field-validation record.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: On-water depth observations on known flats.

gaps.title: Datum coverage blocks most of the fleet
gaps.whyItMatters: Lakes with an acceptable pool and a verified level binding lack a provable datum relationship, so no defensible shift exists for them.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: How many lakes can get a depth shift at all.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the next datum proposal batch is reviewed or the remaining lakes are classified as permanently blocked.
gaps.expectedOutput: Reviewed datum proposals promoted through research tooling into a new candidate release.
